canonical.title: IT conferences and tech events in Hamburg — the 2026 calendar

parent.title: A weekend in Hamburg, anchored on a Michelin dinner

siblings.title: Things to do in Hamburg
siblings.summary: A 48-hour Hamburg playbook anchored on a Michelin dinner: must-see landmarks with booking math, the locals' ferry hack, walkable neighborhoods, casual food, nightlife that's actually worth your time, and the late-May outdoor picks.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Hamburg
siblings.summary: Four restaurants total — two with three stars (Haerlin, The Table), two with two stars (100/200, Lakeside). Concrete picks for a weekend dinner.

sources.title: ITCS Hamburg — official
sources.claim: ITCS Hamburg 2026 runs Fri Jun 26 at Messe Hamburg as a free IT job fair + tech conference + festival with 2 stages, 30+ talks, 80+ exhibitors, after-party 16:00.

sources.title: CollabDays Hamburg 2026
sources.claim: CollabDays Hamburg 2026 runs Sat Jun 27 as a community-led Microsoft 365 / SharePoint / Power Platform / AI day with international speakers; free passes.

sources.title: DevFest Hamburg 2026
sources.claim: DevFest Hamburg 2026 is Fri-Sat Oct 16-17, GDG-organised, covering Android, Web, Cloud, Flutter, Firebase, Angular, Golang.

sources.title: code.talks 2026
sources.claim: code.talks 2026 is Wed-Thu Nov 4-5 at KINOPOLIS HafenCity, 3,500+ devs, 100+ sessions across 13 tracks.

sources.title: OMR Festival
sources.claim: OMR Festival 2026 ran May 5-6 in Hamburg with 67,000+ visitors, 1,000+ exhibitors, 800+ speakers across five stages.

sources.title: found Hamburg 2026 top-10 list
sources.claim: found Hamburg's 2026 list of 10 startup/tech events includes Cursor AI-Hackathon, Future Leader Summit, Health & LS Venture Day.

sources.title: Elbsides 2026
sources.claim: Elbsides 2026 is Hamburg's community-driven cybersecurity conference on Fri Jun 5, with a workshop day Thu Jun 4, at Hotel Hafen Hamburg.

sources.title: Hamburg Innovation Summit
sources.claim: Hamburg Innovation Summit (HHIS) 2026 is Thu Jun 18 at Oberhafenquartier, free entry, 5+ stages over 1,800 sqm.

sources.title: ISC High Performance 2026
sources.claim: ISC High Performance 2026 runs Mon-Fri Jun 22-26 at CCH Hamburg, 3,500+ scientists, 200 technology providers.

sources.title: Product at Heart 2026
sources.claim: Product at Heart 2026 returns to Hamburg with workshops Thu Jun 25 and a single-track conference Fri Jun 26 at Kampnagel.

sources.title: techcamp Hamburg
sources.claim: techcamp Hamburg 2026 is Tue-Wed Aug 25-26 at Klubhaus St. Pauli, ~50 talks across software dev, IT security, infrastructure, web.

sources.title: ContainerDays Hamburg 2026
sources.claim: ContainerDays Hamburg 2026 is Wed-Fri Sep 2-4 at Schuppen 52 on the waterfront; Europe's largest container/Kubernetes conference.

sources.title: KI-SUMMIT Hamburg
sources.claim: KI-SUMMIT Hamburg 2026 is Tue Sep 8 at the Handelskammer Hamburg, focused on AI for SMEs (Mittelstand).

sources.title: Reeperbahn Festival 2026
sources.claim: Reeperbahn Festival 2026 runs Wed-Sat Sep 16-19 across ~70 St. Pauli venues; pairs music with a B2B conference.

sources.title: bit summit 2026
sources.claim: bit summit 2026 runs Wed-Thu Sep 23-24 at Fischauktionshalle Hamburg, covering cloud-native, architecture, security, AI/ML.

sources.title: AI Media Leaders Conference
sources.claim: AI Media Leaders Conference is Thu Nov 12 2026, bringing media + digital decision-makers together with tech and politics.

sources.title: dev.events Hamburg listings
sources.claim: dev.events Hamburg listings include The Principal Dev masterclass (Dec 3-4) and Clean Architecture Masterclass for Java (Dec 10-11).

sources.title: Agentic Conf Hamburg 2026
sources.claim: Agentic Conf Hamburg 2026 ran Sun Mar 22 at SAE Institute, sold-out full-day for ~200-300 builders.

sources.title: AWS Summit Hamburg
sources.claim: AWS Summit Hamburg 2026 ran Wed May 20 at Hamburg Messe; free one-day event, 150+ sessions, 4,408 registered.

sources.title: Reeperbahn Festival start-up contest
sources.claim: Reeperbahn Festival 2026 launches a first-ever start-up contest for music-industry tools; prizes worth >€15,000.

sources.title: Hamburg AWS User Group
sources.claim: Hamburg AWS User Group meets monthly to share AWS topics and welcomes all skill levels including cloud newbies.

sources.title: GDG Hamburg
sources.claim: GDG Hamburg (Google Developer Group) hosts the Google-developer community throughout the year and runs DevFest Hamburg.

sources.title: Agentic Hamburg
sources.claim: Agentic Hamburg is a community of AI-agent builders with over 1,000 members; runs ~4 meetups/year plus an annual full-day conference.

sources.title: Betahaus Hamburg
sources.claim: Betahaus Hamburg has been the Schanzenviertel coworking hub since 2010 and hosts meetups, tech conferences and startup events year-round.

sources.title: WeAreDevelopers World Congress
sources.claim: WeAreDevelopers World Congress 2026 is in Berlin (not Hamburg), Jul 8-10, with 15,000+ participants.

sources.title: NEXT Conference
sources.claim: NEXT Conference, historically Hamburg's digital-business event paired with Reeperbahn Festival, will not run in 2026.
